note: Gate 1 and Gate 3 are FLOORS marked with a triangle, not climbing numbers: every sketch imports to a valid graph whose regenerated source compiles to identical machine code, so both sit at tier size permanently and a drop is a HARD STOP. Re-record with 'npm run import:corpus -- --record' at each phase exit. Gate 2 Tier C sits at 13/16 by design: the millis lift moves a global timestamp declaration into loop() as the node's own static local, which is a real AST difference and exactly the structural change a lift is. Gate 1 confirms the machine code is identical on all three. Phase 3 exit criteria: Tier B Gate 1 stays 17/17 while coverage rises materially.
